sourceUnit.zh: 九年六月，有桑生於宮西廂，日長尺餘，數日而枯。
sourceUnit.en: Year nine saw an omen mulberry sprout west of the halls.
sourceUnit.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year a mulberry sprouted west of the palace, growing over a chi daily for days before withering.

translationRepairs.before: Year nine saw an omen mulberry sprout west of the halls.
translationRepairs.after: In the sixth lunar month of the ninth year, a mulberry sprouted in the palace’s west wing. It grew more than a chi each day, then withered after several days.
translationRepairs.reason: The current idiomatic field omits 六月, the extraordinary daily growth 日長尺餘, and the withering 數日而枯. These describe the event, not expendable stylistic detail. 宮西廂 is the palace’s west wing, not west of the halls. Preserve the lunar month without assuming Gregorian June.

translationRepairs.before: In the sixth month of the ninth year a mulberry sprouted west of the palace, growing over a chi daily for days before withering.
translationRepairs.after: In the sixth lunar month of the ninth year, a mulberry sprouted in the west wing of the palace; it grew more than a chi each day and withered after several days.
translationRepairs.reason: 宮西廂 means the west wing of the palace, rather than a location west of the palace. Retain the sixth lunar month, 尺餘 as more than a chi, and the sequence of daily growth followed by withering after several days; no Gregorian month or metric conversion is supplied.
